text: My education and qualifications are: Thank you for electing me in 2022 to represent you on the Hayward City Council. As a mother, homeowner, attorney, and current Hayward City Councilmember, I am now running for reelection to continue serving our city from newly created Council District 6 in southeast Hayward where my roots run deep. My husband Robert and I have lived in Hayward for 22 years, including the Fairway Park neighborhood since 2009, along with our two kids. Since 2010, my public service work has included: first, serving on my kids’ School Site Council; then on Hayward’s Community Services and Planning Commissions (7 years); and now, on the Hayward City Council. As an attorney, I work with older adults concerned about housing costs, benefits, and financial security. As a Councilmember, I’m focused on fiscal responsibility, good governance, ensuring a safe community in partnership with Hayward police and fire professionals, and protecting our precious natural environment. I am supported by Hayward Mayor Mark Salinas, current and former Hayward City Council colleagues, former Assemblymember Bill Quirk, County Supervisor Elisa Márquez, the Building & Construction Trades Council of Alameda County, and many Hayward civic leaders and community members. I would appreciate your support too. It would be an honor to serve Hayward for another 4 years. If I can be of service, please contact me at julieforhayward@gmail.com. Thank you! www.julieforhayward.com
